# Screenshots Placeholder

This directory is intended to store image files (e.g., PNG, JPG) that capture the issues identified in the QA report.

Because this deliverable was generated without the ability to capture real screenshots, the directory currently contains only this README.

When performing a manual test, replace the placeholder files with actual screenshots and update the `QA_Report.md` file to reference the image paths, for example:

```markdown

```
